evals.prompt: Generate an image of a cute crab-shaped robot vacuum cleaner on a wooden floor, save it to crab_vacuum.png
evals.expected_output: A valid PNG image file named crab_vacuum.png depicting a crab-shaped robot vacuum cleaner on a wooden floor
expectations: A file named crab_vacuum.png exists in the run's outputs directory
crab_vacuum.png is a valid PNG image larger than 50 KB
The image depicts a crab-shaped robot vacuum cleaner

evals.prompt: Edit the file test_cat.png and replace the orange tabby cat with a white husky dog sitting in the same spot. Keep the windowsill, plants, curtains and lighting unchanged. Save the result as husky.png
evals.expected_output: A valid PNG file husky.png showing a white husky dog in place of the orange cat, with the windowsill scene preserved
expectations: A file named husky.png exists in the run's outputs directory
husky.png is a valid PNG image larger than 50 KB
husky.png is not a byte-identical copy of the input test_cat.png
The edited image contains a white/light-colored dog and no orange cat

evals.prompt: Make a 2048x2048 high quality poster of a cyberpunk city at night with neon signs
evals.expected_output: At least one generated PNG image file (auto-named) depicting a cyberpunk city at night with neon signs
expectations: At least one PNG image file was created in the run's outputs directory
The image file is a valid PNG larger than 50 KB
The image depicts a cyberpunk city at night with neon signs
